passives.description:
Anytime this unit hits an enemy with $Freeze:
 - Deal {1}% of this unit's current damage around the enemy 
When $Freeze expires from an enemy:
 - $Slow enemy by {2}% 
If an enemy dies with $Freeze:
 - {3} nearest enemies will take {4}% of this unit's current damage
